title: After Testing Dyson’s New Vacuums Against the Old, There’s a Clear Winner
summary: Both Gen5Detect and V16 Piston Animal were able to vacuum on the thin rug, but the stronger suction also kept trying to take the rug with it, giving both mixed results and leaving a lot of sand behind on each pass.
